declaration.preface: At True Up Companies, we recognize that our role as a Commercial General Contracting and 3PL Company carries a profound responsibility to the environment. Our dedication to environmental stewardship is deeply embedded in our core values, which include passion, integrity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are committed to integrating sustainable practices across all facets of our operations, from fulfillment center buildouts and material handling installations to product logistics. By prioritizing eco-friendly solutions and minimizing our environmental footprint, we aim to contribute positively to the communities we serve and ensure a healthier planet for future generations.
declaration.declaration: We at True Up Companies actively promote environmental responsibility by fostering a culture of sustainability across all levels of our organization. We engage in eco-conscious planning, invest in green technologies, and collaborate with partners who share our commitment to environmental stewardship. By integrating sustainability into our decision-making and daily operations, we aim to drive long-term positive environmental impact while supporting business growth and resilience.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all operations, employees, contractors, and stakeholders of True Up Companies, covering general contracting, 3PL services, and logistics. It addresses energy efficiency, waste management, emissions reduction, and regulatory compliance across offices, project sites, and supply chains. Our commitment ensures sustainability is integrated into decision-making and operational processes.

policy.monitoring: Regular monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement maintain accountability across all levels.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Environmental Compliance Manager at TRUE UP COMPANIES will oversee the annual review of this Environmental Policy to ensure its effectiveness and alignment with the company’s manufacturing operations and sustainability goals. The review will evaluate progress on targets, incorporate stakeholder feedback, ensure compliance with environmental regulations, and reflect advancements in sustainable practices. Any updates or changes will be promptly be communicated to all stakeholders to maintain transparency and accountability.
